text:
maria: Trying to provision the new Dedicated GPU cluster in eu-west-1, but instance registration to the ALB is failing with quota errors.

maria: Seen during autoscale: "Failed to register targets: Target group quota reached" and some ENI attach errors for interface endpoints.

omar: Which quotas are we hitting? target group per load balancer, or VPCE/ENI limits?

maria: From the logs: "Client.InternalError: TooManyTargets: Maximum number of targets reached for targetgroup tg-abc123 (limit 1000)" and also "VPCEndpoint limit reached for account 123456789012 in eu-west-1"

jess: That's the account we're using for Dedicated pools, right? account: 123456789012

ravi: Yes. We're provisioning ~15k pods across 6 ASGs, each node registers multiple targets due to per-pod health checks. We need an increase for:
- ALB TargetGroup targets per target group
- Interface endpoints (com.amazonaws.ec2, com.amazonaws.ecr.dkr, com.amazonaws.logs) per region
- ENI attachments / IP addresses per instance

maria: I opened a support case with AWS, case# 0321123451. AWS response says to request Service Quotas: Elastic Load Balancing L-7A1B2C3 - Target per target group, and VPC Endpoint quotas L-XXXX for interface endpoints.

jess: Can you post the exact Service Quotas CLI commands so I can push through the org account too?

maria: Sure. Running these helps track:
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code elasticloadbalancing --quota-code L-7A1B2C3 --desired-value 5000 --region eu-west-1
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code vpc-endpoints --quota-code L-9Z9Z9Z --desired-value 200 --region eu-west-1
```

omar: Also raise a case with Support to increase ENI / IPv4 address limits: EC2 quota L-ABCDE for "Network interfaces per instance" for the instance types we'll use (g5.12xlarge etc).

infra-bot: Reminder: raise a billing alert when quotas are lifted; we saw a 3x cost spike last time during scale tests. :warning:

maria: Good call. I'll add a temporary cost guardrail: scale cap + CloudWatch alert on ALB request count and Billing alarm.

ravi: Internal note: consider moving health checks to node-port to reduce per-pod target registration, or use target IP mode with fewer registered targets.

jess: If AWS takes >48h, we need a fallback: split traffic to additional target groups or use NLB with target IPs to avoid per-target constraints.

maria: For now tracking: QA ticket #INFRA-7263, support case 0321123451, requested target quota -> 5000, VPCE -> 200, ENI per instance -> 50. I'll post updates when AWS confirms.

aws-support-bot: Update on case 0321123451: Request received, typical review 24-72 hours. If you need expedite, reply with business justification and escalation to TAM.

jess: Thx. Maria, can you add the business justification paragraph? I'll sign off.

maria: Added justification in the case: "Onboarding dedicated inference fleet for customer workloads. Immediate need to support predictable scaling and reduce request throttling during canary rollouts. We will monitor and revert if unused." :thumbsup:

omar: Thanks team. Marking follow-up in eng-infra backlog and tagging oncall if we see more failures.
